services.title: Document Automation & Tabular PDF Data Extraction
services.what_you_sell: Custom Python pipelines that extract structured tabular data from complex, multi-page English and regional language PDFs/scans into clean Excel/CSV/JSON.
services.what_you_know: PyMuPDF, Tesseract OCR (PSM tuning), OpenCV image binarization, Devanagari Unicode regex.
services.target_clients: Law firms, accounting offices, local businesses digitizing physical paper archives.

services.title: FastAPI Backend & Telegram/WhatsApp Bot Automation
services.what_you_sell: Automated notification backends and webhooks that broadcast real-time customer alerts, order confirmations, or price alerts via Telegram or WhatsApp.
services.what_you_know: FastAPI, aiohttp, Telegram Bot API, AsyncIO queues, SQLite/PostgreSQL, Webhook security.
services.target_clients: Traders, local e-commerce stores, service booking businesses.

services.title: Web Scraping & Real-Time Market Monitoring
services.what_you_sell: Automated headless scrapers and monitoring workers that track competitor pricing, public government tenders, or stock listings.
services.what_you_know: Playwright/Selenium, BeautifulSoup, aiohttp, anti-blocking headers, scheduled cron jobs.
services.target_clients: B2B suppliers, e-commerce market researchers, tender contractors.

proposal_framework.milestone_structure: 30% Upfront Advance, 40% on Functional Staging Demo, 30% Prior to Final Code & Credentials Handover.
proposal_framework.scope_protection: Always list explicit 'In-Scope' features and 'Out-of-Scope' items to prevent unpaid feature creep.
